summary: Answer strict exact RFI/Submittal party-field questions locally and ground the same identity, role and complete value in model-generated answers and source findings.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficient accurate questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Explicit workflow responsibility fields are useful only when they remain distinct from Email headers, signatures and general responsibility prose
The existing workflow index and immutable evidence can answer exact labelled fields without a second index or provider cost
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions naming one exact RFI or Submittal and one supported printed party field use the local shortcut.
Email From/To, quoted history, signatures, Ball in Court, company mentions and unlabelled responsibility prose remain outside the field contract.
More than 32 primary files or candidate passages and conflicting explicit values fail closed.
The implementation does not infer identity, responsibility, authority, approval, action ownership or equivalence between different field labels.
